svg.title: HVDC LINK · JOINT STATE 02 · NORMAL CONDUCTION AT BOTH STATIONS
svg.text: HVDC LINK · JOINT STATE 02 · NORMAL CONDUCTION AT BOTH STATIONS

svg.title: Full LCC HVDC circuit — Normal conduction at both stations
svg.desc: Two three-phase, two-winding converter transformers, a six-pulse rectifier, two smoothing reactors, line resistance, a six-pulse inverter, and a metallic return. The red line is the union of validated complete electrical current loops.

text.font-family: STIX Math, STIX, Cambria Math, DejaVu Serif, serif
STIX Math, STIX, Cambria Math, DejaVu Serif, serif

g.text: HVDC LINK · JOINT STATE 02 · NORMAL CONDUCTION AT BOTH STATIONS
Rectifier: T1 + T6 | one upper and one lower SCR carry the DC current | Inverter: T1 + T4 | one upper and one lower SCR carry the DC current
Conceptual model only: ideal sinusoidal sources, constant DC current, linear current transfer during overlap; equal-reactance voltage average. Not an EMT solution.
